color.note: Adire indigo on unbleached cotton, with camwood kept for commitment locks. Every text pair named in a usage note meets 4.5:1 and every control boundary 3:1, in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Unbleached cotton in light, indigo night in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, pocket cards, list containers, the app bar and tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, menus and toasts. In light it is separated by shadow-lg; in dark by its lighter tone.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented control track, keypad background, skeleton blocks, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and the one dark band on the landing page. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts, on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, rule summaries, naira equivalents. On canvas, surface, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders, helper text. On canvas, surface and surface-sunken (4.7:1 minimum in light).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Adire indigo. Fill of the one primary button per view, the active tab indicator and selected controls. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything filled with brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills. Never use white on brand in the dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links, active tab labels, brand-coloured text and icons on canvas, surface and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info notices, the family view header band. Text on it is ink or brand-text.

tokens.name: brand-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on brand-soft rows and chips.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, drawn 2px outside the control. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Camwood. Used only for commitment locks and the eyelet in the logo. Never for errors, never for primary actions.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Camwood text and icons: the Locked badge, lock dates. On canvas, surface and accent-soft (5.7:1 minimum).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Warm cotton behind the Locked badge and the lock notice. Deliberately neutral so a lock never reads as an error or a warning.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money in, success, Final status. Text and icons on canvas, surface and positive-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success notices and Final badges.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Near the limit, pending, needs attention. Text and icons on canvas, surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Background of pending badges and caution notices.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors, declined requests, blocked payments. Text and icons on canvas, surface and negative-soft.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and Declined badges.

tokens.name: negative-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons (Decline, Withdraw all). Text on it is on-negative.

tokens.name: on-negative
tokens.usage: Text and icons on negative-solid.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: pocket-palm
tokens.usage: Palm oil gold. Default for Food. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-palm-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the palm pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-palm-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-palm-tint, and the palm pocket label on surface.

tokens.name: pocket-sky
tokens.usage: Harmattan sky. Default for School fees. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-sky-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the sky pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-sky-tint, and the sky pocket label on surface.

tokens.name: pocket-clay
tokens.usage: Laterite clay. Default for Rent. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-clay-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the clay pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-clay-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-clay-tint, and the clay pocket label on surface.

tokens.name: pocket-teal
tokens.usage: Lagoon teal. Default for Emergency. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the teal pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-teal-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-teal-tint, and the teal pocket label on surface.

tokens.name: pocket-plum
tokens.usage: Plum. Default for Gifts and giving. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-plum-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the plum pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-plum-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-plum-tint, and the plum pocket label on surface.

tokens.name: pocket-olive
tokens.usage: Olive. Default for Transport. Pocket icon disc and the top band of its pocket card. Graphic use only, 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: pocket-olive-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind the olive pocket icon and its label chip.

tokens.name: pocket-olive-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pocket-olive-tint, and the olive pocket label on surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, for product-written headings and large amounts only. The shipped file carries English, currency and number glyphs, so names, labels and memos typed by people never use it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Money sent home, with a purpose.
styles.usage: Landing hero on expanded screens only.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Money sent home, with a purpose.
styles.usage: Landing hero on compact screens; page titles on expanded screens.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Page titles on compact and medium screens.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter carries every Yoruba, Igbo and Hausa letter and the naira sign, so all interface text and anything people type uses it.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Pocket labels, card titles, request titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Group labels inside cards and sheets.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Mama can spend up to 40 USDC a week from Food.
styles.usage: Landing copy and the family view, where readers are less practised.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Anything above the limit becomes a request you approve.
styles.usage: Default text and every input value. Inputs never go below 16px, which stops iOS from zooming.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, tab bar labels, helper text under amounts. The smallest text in the product.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above sections, in English product copy only; never uppercase user text or Yoruba.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Every amount sets tabular figures (the ek-num class) so columns and live balances never shift.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The balance on a pocket page and the amount being typed on the keypad.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: The balance on a pocket card.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Amounts in the activity feed and on request cards.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for machine strings only.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Full addresses and receipt numbers in detail views.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Shortened addresses in rows and chips.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile gutters are space-4; expanded gutters are space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a card; button padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Compact screen gutter; card padding on compact screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on medium and expanded screens; button padding inline.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; expanded screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above page titles on expanded screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major landing sections on compact screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major landing sections on expanded screens.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Landing hero padding on expanded screens.

radius.note: Soft corners from the tied circles of adire oniko; buttons and chips are full pills.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Skeleton lines, small inline chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in dense rows, keypad keys, segmented control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, notices, list containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and pocket cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, tabs, avatars, meters.

shadow.note: Light theme lifts with soft indigo-tinted shadows; dark theme relies on tone and hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Segmented control thumb, pressed keypad key.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, the sticky tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs and toasts.

size.note: Hit areas follow the 44pt iOS and 48dp Android minimums.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and captions.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, rows and inputs.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar, app bar and empty-state icons.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards on expanded screens only.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary action of a screen or sheet on compact screens.

tokens.name: size-tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, even when the visible shape is smaller.

tokens.name: size-keypad-key
tokens.usage: Keys on the amount keypad.

tokens.name: size-appbar
tokens.usage: Top app bar height on compact screens, before the safe area.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the safe area inset.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Navigation rail width on medium screens.

tokens.name: size-sidenav
tokens.usage: Side navigation width on expanded screens.

tokens.name: size-sheet-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: size-reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a single column of text or a form.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content area beside the side navigation.

breakpoint.note: Compact is the default below bp-medium. Values are min-widths.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: Tablets portrait and large phones landscape: navigation rail, two-column pocket grid, sheets become centred dialogs.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: Laptops and tablets landscape: side navigation, detail panel beside lists.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Large desktops: three-column pocket grid, content centred at size-content-max.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky app bar and section headers.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Tab bar, rail and side navigation.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Scrim, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above sheets.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Always pair with aria-disabled and a reason nearby.
